usage: 好合身 describes how well clothes fit someone’s body.
It is usually used to talk about clothing that is not too tight or too loose.
You can use 好合身 before or after the noun that describes the clothing item.
It is a positive comment about comfort and appearance of the clothes.
好合身 can also imply that the style suits the wearer.

examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 hap6 san1

examples.sentence: 我買咗條褲，好合身，唔太緊。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 fu3, hou2 hap6 san1, m4 taai3 gan2
examples.meaning: I bought these pants, they fit well and are not too tight.

examples.sentence: 你試下呢件，應該會好合身。
examples.jyutping: nei5 si3 haa5 ni1 gin6, jing1 goi1 wui5 hou2 hap6 san1
examples.meaning: Try this one, it should fit well.

examples.sentence: 佢條裙真係好合身，好靚呀！
examples.jyutping: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hap6 san1, hou2 leng3 aa3
examples.meaning: Her skirt really fits well, looks very nice!

related: 試衫 (si3 saam1) - try on clothes
